title: Plural genitive of selected -ija/-ijä words
focus: Change final -a to -o- or final -ä to -ö- before -iden or -itten in these person words: opiskelija (“student”) → opiskelijoiden.

exercises.prompt: Choose the plural genitive of opiskelija (“student”).
exercises.explanation: Change final a to o: opiskelijo- + iden/itten = opiskelijoiden/opiskelijoitten. These standard forms are all accepted: opiskelijoiden, opiskelijoitten.

optionFeedback.opiskelijoiden: Change final a to o: opiskelijo- + iden/itten = opiskelijoiden/opiskelijoitten. These standard forms are all accepted: opiskelijoiden, opiskelijoitten.
optionFeedback.opiskelija: opiskelija is the dictionary form; this question needs the plural genitive.
optionFeedback.opiskelijan: opiskelijan does not use the plural genitive stem and ending for opiskelija.
